title: Personal and professional values as a Muslim psychologist - with Elisha Hussain

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换取金钱，还能赚取更多收入会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年亲自完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两届心理学家走过他们的历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，且无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四个小组智囊团、大师班、个性化指导、福特纳姆与梅森美食，以及限时的一对一教练福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: This podcast, that's your side, you'll be on your way.
sentences.zh: 这个播客，这就是你的方向，你将踏上征程。

sentences.en: It's the Aspiring Psychologist with Dr. Marianne Turek.
sentences.zh: 这是玛丽安·特雷克博士主持的《有志心理学家》。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有志心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: Thank you for joining me.
sentences.zh: 感谢你的加入。

sentences.en: This episode is scheduled to be released on Monday the 14th of November 2022.
sentences.zh: 这期节目预定于2022年11月14日星期一发布。

sentences.en: If you are listening to it in that week,
sentences.zh: 如果你是在那一周收听的，

sentences.en: then please do bear in mind that the application deadline for the doctorate in clinical psychology for the clearinghouse applications is 1pm on Wednesday the 16th of November.
sentences.zh: 请记住，临床心理学博士学位清算所申请的截止日期是11月16日星期三下午1点。

sentences.en: I'm sure that won't have passed you by, but I just wanted to get that on your radar.
sentences.zh: 我相信这不会逃过你的注意，但我只是想提醒你注意这一点。

sentences.en: So today's episode is a guest episode and I am joined by Alicia Hussain.
sentences.zh: 所以今天的节目是一期嘉宾访谈节目，和我一起的是艾莉莎·侯赛因。

sentences.en: And it would be advantageous for you to listen to the episode on values if you haven't done so already.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没听过关于价值观的那期节目，建议你去听一下，会对你很有帮助。

sentences.en: That is episode 42 of the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 那是播客的第42期。

sentences.en: So if you haven't listened to that, it might be useful for you to do that and then come back here for episode 49.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你还没听过，去听一下可能会很有用，然后再回到这里收听第49期。

sentences.en: But if you want to plow on regardless, please do.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想不管三七二十一继续听下去，也请便。

sentences.en: So Alicia and I met on LinkedIn and, well, you will find out how and why we got chatting.
sentences.zh: 我和艾莉莎是在领英上认识的，嗯，你会发现我们是怎么开始聊天的以及为什么聊天。

sentences.en: But it's all about values.
sentences.zh: 但这全都是关于价值观的。

sentences.en: And we decided it would be useful to have a conversation about Alicia's culture,
sentences.zh: 我们决定聊聊艾莉莎的文化、

sentences.en: faith and background and how they align and how she keeps striving for her values as an aspiring psychologist whilst staying true to her other values,
sentences.zh: 信仰和背景，它们是如何契合的，以及作为一名有志心理学家，她在追求价值观的同时，如何保持对自己其他价值观的忠诚，

sentences.en: both personally and professionally too.
sentences.zh: 无论是个人还是职业层面。

sentences.en: I hope you'll find it super interesting and super useful.
sentences.zh: 我希望你会觉得超级有趣、超级有用。

sentences.en: I know I did.
sentences.zh: 我知道我是这么觉得的。

sentences.en: And I will catch you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目后半部分见。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听。

sentences.en: It is our first guest episode for a while.
sentences.zh: 这是我们一段时间以来的第一期嘉宾访谈节目。

sentences.en: I'm delighted to introduce you to Alicia Hussain.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴向大家介绍艾莉莎·侯赛因。

sentences.en: Hi, Alicia.
sentences.zh: 嗨，艾莉莎。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for coming on.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你来参加。

sentences.en: And thank you also for giving me the idea originally for the values based podcast episode.
sentences.zh: 也谢谢你最初给我的那期关于价值观的播客节目提供了灵感。

sentences.en: Very welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: I think when I kind of put out a LinkedIn post, I feel like you're really active on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 我觉得当我发了一篇领英动态时，我觉得你在领英上真的非常活跃。

sentences.en: And I always kind of like your posts and things like that.
sentences.zh: 而且我总是很喜欢你的帖子之类的内容。

sentences.en: So it was really kind of helpful to have that episode to kind of help me with thinking about values.
sentences.zh: 所以有这样一期节目来帮助我思考价值观，真的是非常有帮助。

sentences.en: So that was really helpful for me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说真的很有用。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: I love LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢领英。

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我是认真的。

sentences.en: I can't deny it.
sentences.zh: 我无法否认这一点。

sentences.en: But yeah, thank you for being involved and engaged with me on there.
sentences.zh: 不过是的，谢谢你在上面与我互动和交流。

sentences.en: So, but then after that, we thought, well, actually, this is really interesting to think about you specifically and some of your values.
sentences.zh: 但随后我们想，其实，深入思考你个人以及你的一些价值观会非常有趣。

sentences.en: And specifically, we thought it might be useful in terms of your career, but also your culture and your background.
sentences.zh: 特别是，我们认为这不仅对你的职业生涯有用，对你的文化和背景也很有用。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, I think I think it's always nice to kind of like watch your podcasts and think about people who've kind of already been through that journey.
sentences.zh: 对，对，我觉得观看你的播客，并思考那些已经经历过这段旅程的人，总是件很美好的事。

sentences.en: But I think it would be really nice to kind of share share my journey.
sentences.zh: 但我认为分享我自己的旅程也会非常棒。

sentences.en: And hopefully when people listen to it, I can either relate to it or maybe kind of think about the differences or like just inspire them around their own journey.
sentences.zh: 希望人们在听的时候，要么能产生共鸣，要么能思考其中的差异，或者只是从他们自己的旅程中获得启发。

sentences.en: So hopefully it can have an impact on people.
sentences.zh: 所以希望它能对人们产生影响。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: I think it's so useful when we are working in mental health to be able to have, you know, examples of people that we can kind of hold as case studies.
sentences.zh: 我认为当我们从事心理健康工作时，能够拥有我们可以作为案例研究的人的例子，是极其有用的。

sentences.en: So if people don't know much about, you know, your faith, your culture or, you know, how it might be, even for someone living in a different part of the country, you know,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果人们对你的信仰、你的文化或者，你知道的，即使对于生活在国家不同地区的人来说情况可能是怎样的，了解得不多，

sentences.en: it's useful for people to have that awareness.
sentences.zh: 那么让人们有这种意识是很有用的。

sentences.en: So I think it's yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，是的。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for doing this.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你参加。

sentences.en: But also we realized in our discussion before we got started was that you are our first aspiring psychologist on the aspiring psychologist podcast, which feels a bit wrong.
sentences.zh: 但在开始之前的讨论中我们也意识到，你是《有志心理学家》播客迎来的第一位有志心理学家，这感觉有点不对劲。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I'm sorry it's taken me 10 months to get here.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，很抱歉我花了10个月才走到这一步。

sentences.en: But I know we had Rose, who is a trainee, but you were our first non-trainee aspiring psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 但我知道我们有过罗斯，她是一名实习生，但你是我们第一位非实习生的有志心理学家。

sentences.en: So, yes, thank you so much for for coming on.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，非常感谢你能来。

sentences.en: And if you're listening to this episode or if you're watching on YouTube as well and you're thinking, oh, I might like to come on the podcast, I'm an aspiring psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在收听这期节目，或者也在YouTube上观看，并且在想，“哦，我也许想上这个播客，我是一名有志心理学家。”

sentences.en: Please do get in contact with me.
sentences.zh: 请务必与我联系。

sentences.en: And as you as Alicia said, you can't miss me on socials.
sentences.zh: 正如艾莉莎所说，你在社交媒体上绝对不会错过我。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent most places.
sentences.zh: 我大部分地方都叫玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: So don't be shy.
sentences.zh: 所以不要害羞。

sentences.en: Do get in contact or just engage with my content.
sentences.zh: 一定要联系我，或者直接与我的内容互动。

sentences.en: We'll get into conversations and marvellous things can happen.
sentences.zh: 我们会开始对话，奇妙的事情就会发生。

sentences.en: So Alicia, tell me a little bit about yourself, a little bit personally, a little bit professionally, if that's OK.
sentences.zh: 所以艾莉莎，请跟我谈谈你自己，如果可以的话，聊一点你的个人情况，再聊一点你的职业情况。

sentences.en: So yeah, so well, where do I start?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么，我该从哪里开始呢？

sentences.en: So yeah, so I suppose I'm Muslim by background and I've kind of been pursuing psychology, I'd probably say since school.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想我的背景是穆斯林，而且我大概从上学的时候起就一直在追求心理学。

sentences.en: And I think kind of outside of psychology, I kind of just like to kind of focus on my own well-being.
sentences.zh: 我想在心理学之外，我只是喜欢专注于我自己的健康状况。

sentences.en: I've started to try to be more persistent with going to things like gym and things like that.
sentences.zh: 我开始尝试更加坚持去健身房之类的地方。

sentences.en: And hopefully something that I can kind of get back into.
sentences.zh: 希望这是我能重新开始做的事情。

sentences.en: So I have been kind of trying to take some time to look after myself.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直在试图腾出一些时间来照顾自己。

sentences.en: I think my journey within kind of psychology started probably in school.
sentences.zh: 我想我在心理学领域的旅程大概是从学校开始的。

sentences.en: So I was really lucky to do psychology as a GCSE, which I think when I did it, it wasn't really heard of.
sentences.zh: 我很幸运能在GCSE（普通中等教育证书）阶段学习心理学，我想在我学的时候，这还不是很常见。

sentences.en: So it was this new, exciting thing.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个全新的、令人兴奋的事物。

sentences.en: And yeah, it really kind of interested me.
sentences.zh: 是的，它真的很吸引我。

sentences.en: But yeah, I think when I kind of started looking into it, I found it really helpful.
sentences.zh: 但是的，我想当我开始深入了解它时，我发现它真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: But I think when I had my own kind of difficulties with mental health, it really opened up my eyes around what I want to pursue in the future.
sentences.zh: 不过我想，当我经历了自己的心理健康困扰时，它真正打开了我的眼界，让我明确了未来想要追求的方向。

sentences.en: And I think having my own experiences of mental health really kind of guided me into this career pathway.
sentences.zh: 我认为拥有自己的心理健康经历真正引导我走上了这个职业道路。

sentences.en: And I'm thinking about how I can move on from my experiences and how I can reflect on my experiences to kind of help others.
sentences.zh: 我在思考如何从我的经历中走出来，以及如何反思我的经历来帮助他人。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I suppose when I started college, I did psychology as an A-level and I was volunteering with Childline at the time.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我想当我开始上大学预科时，我把心理学作为A-level（高级水平考试）科目，当时我还在生命热线（Childline）做志愿者。

sentences.en: So I found it a really helpful experience to be able to kind of have some direct contact with young people and start kind of giving back and using the things that I've experienced and using my knowledge to kind of help other people.
sentences.zh: 我发现这是一段非常宝贵的经历，能够与年轻人有一些直接接触，开始回馈社会，并运用我的经历和知识来帮助其他人。

sentences.en: And then kind of going on from that, I started in university, did my psychology degree and also kind of started building up my experience.
sentences.zh: 在此基础之上，我进入了大学，攻读了心理学学位，并开始积累我的经验。

sentences.en: So I was really lucky to have the experience to volunteer.
sentences.zh: 我很幸运有机会去做志愿者。

sentences.en: So, yeah, so when I was volunteering alongside my degree, I volunteered in a place called Paws, which is a mental health dropping centre for young people.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，当我在攻读学位的同时做志愿者时，我在一个叫PAUSE的地方做志愿者，这是一个面向年轻人的心理健康得益中心（drop-in centre）。

sentences.en: And it was one of the most eye opening experiences I've had because not only kind of just working with young people and supporting them,
sentences.zh: 这是我经历过最开阔眼界的经历之一，因为不仅是与年轻人工作并支持他们，

sentences.en: but just kind of how a service that's so easily accessible can have such an impact on young people's lives.
sentences.zh: 而且还关于如此容易获得的普惠服务如何能对年轻人的生活产生如此大的影响。

sentences.en: So I really kind of enjoyed just getting to know people,
sentences.zh: 所以我真的很享受去了解人们，

sentences.en: kind of working with people and kind of getting my head around how things worked and having that opportunity to kind of support people and actually learn more about psychology in the process.
sentences.zh: 与人们共事，琢磨事情是如何运作的，并获得这个机会去支持人们，并在过程中实际了解更多关于心理学的知识。

sentences.en: So for me, that was really powerful.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，那是极其强大的。

sentences.en: I had the opportunity to be employed by the service, which was really amazing, to be honest, and I love my time there.
sentences.zh: 我有机会被该服务机构雇用，说实话这真的很棒，我非常喜欢我在那里的时光。

sentences.en: So I would just kind of work with people when they kind of dropped into the service around kind of any of their emotional health and well-being needs and whatever they wanted to talk about,
sentences.zh: 所以当人们来到服务中心咨询他们的任何情绪健康和福祉需求以及他们想谈论的任何事情时，我就会与他们合作，

sentences.en: really.
sentences.zh: 真的。

sentences.en: And so that really put me in a good stead when I was thinking about applying for assistant psychologist posts.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我考虑申请助理心理学家职位时，这为我打下了很好的基础。

sentences.en: So I was really lucky to get an assistant psychologist post straight after my role there.
sentences.zh: 我很幸运在那里的角色之后直接得到了一份助理心理学家的工作。

sentences.en: And that's where I'm working at the moment.
sentences.zh: 这就是我目前工作的地方。

sentences.en: So I'm currently working within Black Country Health Care Trust within a service called Action for Children, which kind of covers the area of Staffordshire.
sentences.zh: 我目前在黑乡医疗信托基金（Black Country Health Care Trust）的一个名为“行动为了儿童”（Action for Children）的服务机构工作，该机构大致覆盖斯塔福德郡地区。

sentences.en: And basically, I work with young people again, young people and children.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我还是与年轻人合作，年轻人和儿童。

sentences.en: And I think I've really found it helpful to work with young people and children.
sentences.zh: 我想我发现与年轻人和儿童合作真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: I think potentially when I when I'm working with young people, I kind of reflect on my own experiences of struggling with my mental health when I was a child.
sentences.zh: 可能当我和年轻人合作时，我会反思自己小时候与心理健康作斗争的经历。

sentences.en: So I think it was just something that I found really kind of helpful for me as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这对我自己来说也是非常受用的事情。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I've been working with young people to kind of support them to do kind of evidence based interventions and supporting them with their well-being.
sentences.zh: 因此，是的，我一直在与年轻人合作，支持他们进行基于证据的干预，并支持他们的身心健康。

sentences.en: And, yeah, I've really enjoyed every moment of it.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，我真的很享受其中的每一刻。

sentences.en: And I think it's just been really helpful to be able to kind of have the experience I've had and kind of give back and at the same time.
sentences.zh: 我认为能够拥有我所拥有的经历并同时回馈社会，真的是非常有益的。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢这样了。

sentences.en: And actually, I absolutely like you said, there's something very different about putting your theory into practice, isn't there, for the first time?
sentences.zh: 事实上，正如你所说，把理论付诸实践，第一次这样做，这之间有着非常不同的体验，对吧？

sentences.en: And actually starting to do, you know,
sentences.zh: 开始去做，

sentences.en: I'm guessing what you've been doing is one to one work with people and starting to do that and starting to explore the comfortability of being in a room with somebody and trying to use that time together to make a difference.
sentences.zh: 我猜你一直在做的是与人们进行一对一的工作，开始做这件事，并开始探索与某人共处一室的舒适感，并试图利用这段在一起的时间来产生影响。

sentences.en: And that's a really wonderful experience that you're able to get even before you were doing assistant work.
sentences.zh: 这是一段非常美妙的经历，甚至在你做助理工作之前就能获得。

sentences.en: It sounds incredible.
sentences.zh: 听起来太不可思议了。

sentences.en: You're starting to make a difference and get that little buzz that we get from, you know, people saying this is working.
sentences.zh: 你开始产生影响，并获得那种来自人们说“这很有效”、“这带来了改变”的小兴奋。

sentences.en: This is making a difference.
sentences.zh: 这带来了改变。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对的。

sentences.en: I think I think it was just kind of helpful to have that firsthand experience, but also kind of being able to lean into the experience and actually develop alongside.
sentences.zh: 我想，拥有第一手经验很有帮助，但能够融入这种经验并在其中共同成长也是很有帮助的。

sentences.en: Because I feel like with any kind of role where you work in someone's mental health, I think you get a lot of imposter syndrome.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得在任何从事心理健康工作的岗位上，你都会有很多冒名顶替综合征（imposter syndrome）。

sentences.en: And I think for me, that was a big thing, especially with my first assistant post where I was thinking, I do not belong.
sentences.zh: 我认为对我来说，这是一件大事，尤其是在我的第一份助理岗位上，我当时在想，我不属于这里。

sentences.en: I've just kind of gotten here by fluke.
sentences.zh: 我只是凭运气来到这里的。

sentences.en: And I think it was really helpful to learn that actually it's OK to develop as you're working and reflect on your experiences,
sentences.zh: 我认为了解在工作中成长并反思自己的经验其实是没问题的，这真的很有帮助，

sentences.en: because that's what helps to develop you as a practitioner, really.
sentences.zh: 因为这正是帮助你成长为一名从业者的关键。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: I know that some other audience will be like, well, how long did you work in that post then before you got your assistant post?
sentences.zh: 我知道其他听众会想，好吧，你在那个岗位上工作了多久才得到助理的职位？

sentences.en: And how long after graduation did you get your assistant post?
sentences.zh: 你毕业后多久拿到助理职位的？

sentences.en: Can you give us a little bit of kind of time frame, if that's OK?
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，你能给我们提供一个大致的时间范围吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: So when I was kind of volunteering within PAUSE, I was working kind of part time alongside my undergraduate degree.
sentences.zh: 当我在PAUSE做志愿者时，我是一边攻读本科一边兼职工作的。

sentences.en: So I think I was working part time, I'd say probably for a year.
sentences.zh: 我想我兼职工作的时间大概有一年吧。

sentences.en: And then I was lucky enough to kind of be employed by the same service.
sentences.zh: 然后我很幸运被同一个服务机构雇用了。

sentences.en: And I was working with them for two years part time.
sentences.zh: 我和他们兼职工作了两年。

sentences.en: And I think for me, the main thing that kind of helped me when I was kind of applying for the assistant psychologist role was
sentences.zh: 我想对我来说，在申请助理心理学家职位时真正有帮助的主要事情是，

sentences.en: I had that two years of part time experience, which really equated to one full year of experience.
sentences.zh: 我有两年的兼职经验，这实际上相当于一整年的全职经验。

sentences.en: But I think for me, what helped even more was the service that I was applying to.
sentences.zh: 但我认为对我更有帮助的是我申请的那家机构。

sentences.en: I really was able to kind of cater my experience to that service.
sentences.zh: 我真的能够根据该机构的情况来调整我的经验。

sentences.en: So having worked with young people and using interventions with young people within PAUSE and then applying for an assistant role,
sentences.zh: 因此，在PAUSE与年轻人合作并在年轻人身上使用干预措施，然后申请助理职位，

sentences.en: I was really able to kind of reflect on my experiences and how I would be able to kind of manage the differences of working within PAUSE and then working within a different service.
sentences.zh: 我真的能够反思我的经历，以及我将如何能够应对在PAUSE工作和在不同机构工作的差异。

sentences.en: And I think that really helped me.
sentences.zh: 我认为这真的对我有很大帮助。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。

sentences.en: But, you know, I think one of the difficult things about counting, you know, whole time equivalents is that, you know,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，计算全时当量（whole time equivalents）困难的事情之一在于，

sentences.en: I said it before in the podcast when I did my honorary post, it equated actually probably to like 10 days, which isn't even half a month.
sentences.zh: 我之前在播客中说过，当我做荣誉职位时，它实际上大概只相当于10天，甚至连半个月都不到。

sentences.en: But because that was spread over probably three or four months,
sentences.zh: 但因为那是分散在大约三四个月里进行的，

sentences.en: the amount of learning and development and, you know, increasing in my confidence I was able to do within that couple of months was amazing.
sentences.zh: 我在那几个月里能够学到、发展并增强自信心的程度是惊人的。

sentences.en: You know, and, you know, what we were saying before we began as well was that we really need to be changing and developing and reflecting.
sentences.zh: 你知道，正如我们在开始之前所说的那样，我们确实需要不断改变、发展和反思。

sentences.en: And in the two year period, you're going to be a very different person, even from the very extent that your brain is going to be more developed,
sentences.zh: 而且在这两年期间，你会成为一个非常不同的人，甚至从你的大脑会更加发达的程度来看，

sentences.en: you know, in terms of if you went to uni at 18, you come out at 21.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像如果你在18岁上大学，21岁毕业那样。

sentences.en: By the time you're 23, your brain is almost kind of fully done-ish, you know, in terms of your frontal lobes and everything.
sentences.zh: 等你到23岁时，你的大脑就差不多完全发育成熟了，我是说就你的额叶和所有这些而言。

sentences.en: You're going to change.
sentences.zh: 你会改变的。

sentences.en: If you haven't changed a great deal within those two years, that would be more worrying.
sentences.zh: 如果你在这两年内没有发生很大的变化，那反而更让人担心。

sentences.en: But of course you were then, because you've been talking the talk and walking the walk for two years and doing one-to-one work.
sentences.zh: 但你当时当然变了，因为你已经言行一致地坚持了两年，并做了一对一的工作。

sentences.en: So even though I hear you on the imposter syndrome, I would say that you were most very well qualified and experienced to be able to get that assistant poSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管我理解你对冒名顶替综合征的感受，但我得说，你完全有资格并且非常有经验去争取那个助理岗位。

sentences.en: And I'm not at all surprised that you did get it.
sentences.zh: 而且你最终拿下了这个职位，我一点也不觉得惊讶。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think reflecting back now, I do feel like I was ready at that time and I feel like it helped me to apply at the right time.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想现在回想起来，我确实觉得当时自己已经准备好了，而且我觉得这帮我在对的时间进行了申请。

sentences.en: And I think using those reflection skills really helped me to think actually I do feel ready now because I was considering it for a while.
sentences.zh: 并且我认为运用这些反思技巧确实帮我意识到，其实我现在真的感觉准备好了，因为我考虑这件事已经有一段时间了。

sentences.en: But I thought, actually, I want to get more out of this role before I do that.
sentences.zh: 但我当时想，事实上，在做那件事之前，我想从这个角色中收获更多。

sentences.en: And it totally resonates with me around how actually even if you're working kind of once every week or like a really kind of sparse amount of time in a different role,
sentences.zh: 这完全引起了我的共鸣，比如，即使你每周只工作一次，或者在不同的岗位上只花极少的时间，

sentences.en: it really helps because I suppose alongside my current assistant role within Action for Children, I'm also doing a role swap with another service.
sentences.zh: 这也真的很有帮助，因为我想除了我目前在“儿童行动”组织担任的助理职务之外，我还与其他服务部门进行了岗位轮换。

sentences.en: So once every fortnight, I go over to the autism assessment team and kind of support that team around autism assessments.
sentences.zh: 所以每两周一次，我会去自闭症评估团队，并在自闭症评估方面为那个团队提供一些支持。

sentences.en: And actually, although it's once a fortnight, you think, well, that's not a lot of experience.
sentences.zh: 事实上，虽然每两周才去一次，你可能会觉得，这并没有多少经验。

sentences.en: But actually, just those kind of first couple of times I've done that role swap, but I've actually got so much out of it that you really kind of value that time.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，仅仅通过前几次的岗位轮换，我真的从中收获良多，你会由衷地珍视那段时间。

sentences.en: And it's not kind of the quantity, but the quality of what you're learning and what you're developing that really helps.
sentences.zh: 重要的不是数量，而是你所学到的东西以及你所获得的成长的质量，这才是真正有帮助的。

sentences.en: That sounds brilliant.
sentences.zh: 听起来太棒了。

sentences.en: Have you sorted that out yourself informally?
sentences.zh: 这是你自己非正式地安排好的吗？

sentences.en: Was that something that was offered to you?
sentences.zh: 还是别人主动提供给你的机会？

sentences.en: So I'd never heard of a role swap before, and my supervisor kind of introduced me to the idea of it.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未听说过岗位轮换，是我的主管向我介绍了这个想法。

sentences.en: So I'm doing it within the same trust that I'm working in.
sentences.zh: 所以我是在我目前工作的同一个信托基金内进行这项工作的。

sentences.en: So what we did is we have a kind of assistant psychologist group within the truSt.
sentences.zh: 我们做的是，我们在信托基金内部有一个助理心理学家小组。

sentences.en: And I kind of approached someone who was in another service that I wanted to kind of get some more experience in.
sentences.zh: 我联系了另一个服务部门的人，而我一直想去那个部门积累更多经验。

sentences.en: And our supervisors kind of met with us and we kind of drew up a bit of a contract just to formalise things.
sentences.zh: 然后我们的主管和我们见了面，我们起草了一份简单的协议，只是为了让事情变得正式。

sentences.en: So, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，

sentences.en: I'm getting kind of experience in her service and she's getting experience in mine and we're kind of supporting each other while still being in the same role that we're in.
sentences.zh: 我在她的部门积累经验，而她在我的部门积累经验，我们在保持现有职位的同时间互相支持。

sentences.en: So it's kind of having that comfort of being in the same service, but still getting more experience, which I didn't know existed, but it's great.
sentences.zh: 所以这种感觉既有留在原部门的舒适感，又能获得更多经验，我以前甚至不知道还有这种方式，但真的很棒。

sentences.en: I absolutely love that.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢这个主意了。

sentences.en: And that's making me a little bit misty eyed as well, because in the Aspiring Psychologist Collective,
sentences.zh: 这甚至让我有点热泪盈眶，因为在“有抱负的心理学家集体”中，

sentences.en: I talk about when I was an aspiring psychologist and I came up with this idea of the assistant psychologist skills exchange,
sentences.zh: 我经常谈到当我还是个有抱负的心理学家时，我想出了这个“助理心理学家技能交流”的主意，

sentences.en: which is basically what you're saying, you know, you hang out with other people and kind of do their job with them.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是你所说的，你和其他人待在一起，和他们一起做他们的工作。

sentences.en: But actually you're swapping, which is even better, because then you kind of have to kind of get on and do it.
sentences.zh: 但实际上你们是在互换岗位，这就更棒了，因为这样你就不得不硬着头皮去把它做好。

sentences.en: And I think, like you said, you know, when you're doing something once a fortnight, still, that's twice a month, you can still learn so much.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得，就像你说的，当你每两周做一次某事时，那也是一个月两次，你仍然可以学到很多东西。

sentences.en: And it just gives you, you know, it thickens your narrative in that area of work.
sentences.zh: 它能赋予你，你知道的，丰富你在那个工作领域的经历叙事。

sentences.en: So that it's another tip, you know, because what we're looking at generally, not necessarily the people who are employing you, but we feel like when we're aspiring,
sentences.zh: 所以这是另一个建议，你知道的，因为我们通常关注的——不一定是雇佣你的人，但当我们作为有抱负的心理学家时，

sentences.en: which is we kind of want to do, you know, want to tick off older adults, you want to tick off, you know, children and young people.
sentences.zh: 就是我们想要做到，你知道的，想要勾选老年人服务，你想要勾选，你知道的，儿童和青少年服务。

sentences.en: We want to tick off, you know, intellectual learning disabilities and, you know, autism.
sentences.zh: 我们想要勾选，你知道的，智力学习障碍以及，你知道的，自闭症。

sentences.en: And, you know, it gives you another thing that just helps you feel like you've got less Achilles heels, you know.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，这能为你提供另一项优势，让你觉得自己的“阿喀琉斯之踵”变少了，你知道的。

sentences.en: So we absolutely go to training with Achilles heels, with things that we know we need to learn and shape and develop, and everything should be shaped and developed during training.
sentences.zh: 所以我们去参加培训时，身上确实带着“阿喀琉斯之踵”，带着那些我们知道自己需要去学习、塑造和发展的东西，而且在培训期间，一切都应该得到塑造和发展。

sentences.en: But, you know, for you to feel like you are, you've earned your stripes enough to be there.
sentences.zh: 但是，为了让你觉得自己已经足够有资格呆在那里、付出了应有的努力，

sentences.en: I think that's really, really useful.
sentences.zh: 我认为这真的非常非常有帮助。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And I think I'm really lucky that I'm in a post right now.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得自己真的很幸运，现在能拥有这样一个岗位。

sentences.en: That's I've been in the post for over a year and my contract keeps getting extended, thankfully.
sentences.zh: 我已经在这个岗位上待了一年多了，谢天谢地，我的合同一直在续签。

sentences.en: But, yeah, it's nice to not kind of be in that position where I have to leave to get more experience,
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，不用处于那种为了获得更多经验而不得不离开的境地，这种感觉真好，

sentences.en: because I think sometimes when you're enjoying an AP job and you have that ability to kind of stay there,
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得有时候当你正享受一份助理心理学的工作并且能够留下来时，

sentences.en: actually, it's nice to explore those different options without having to leave where you're currently at.
sentences.zh: 去探索这些不同的选择而不必离开你目前的地方，其实是一件很美好的事。

sentences.en: And I think that's a really nice way to get experience and understand what you enjoy doing and as well as a tick box,
sentences.zh: 我认为这不仅是打勾完成任务、积累经验的一种非常好的方式，而且还能让你明白自己到底喜欢做什么，

sentences.en: kind of getting that experience, just finding out what you enjoy in terms of when you're working as well.
sentences.zh: 在实际工作中去发现自己真正享受的是什么。

sentences.en: So that's been nice.
sentences.zh: 所以这感觉真不错。

sentences.en: That is brilliant.
sentences.zh: 这太棒了。

sentences.en: And actually, what you get to do is you get to deepen your relationships with the team you're working in
sentences.zh: 事实上，你能做的是加深你与正在合作的团队、你的主管以及管理人员之间的关系，

sentences.en: and with your supervisor and managerial staff, too, because it can feel a little bit like treadmill-y, can't it?
sentences.zh: 因为这有时会让人感觉像是在原地踏步、枯燥乏味，对吧？

sentences.en: With, you know, people just coming on to a role and then dropping off.
sentences.zh: 看着人们不断地加入一个岗位，然后又离开。

sentences.en: But I know that qualified staff listen to this podcast sometimes, too.
sentences.zh: 但我知道有资质的员工有时也会听这个播客。

sentences.en: And so this is a way of actually retaining your staff and having your staff be able to think deeper
sentences.zh: 所以这也是一种能够留住员工、让员工能够更深入、

sentences.en: and, you know, more holistically about the clients and services you're working with.
sentences.zh: 更全面地思考你们所接触的客户和服务的途径。

sentences.en: So I would urge you to think about whether you might be able to do, I've forgotten what it's called, role swap, was it?
sentences.zh: 所以我敦促你们考虑一下，看自己是否能做那种我忘了叫什么名字的东西，是叫岗位轮换吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, role swap within your service because it's going to bring value to your service.
sentences.zh: 对，对，在你的服务部门内进行岗位轮换，因为这会给你的部门带来价值。

sentences.en: Even, you know, you seeing the way that they set up, you know, referrals, assessments, you know, talking about team meetings and stuff, all of that.
sentences.zh: 甚至，你知道的，你看到他们建立转诊、评估的方式，你知道的，旁听团队会议等等，所有这些。

sentences.en: If you see something that's working well in practice for another service, you're more likely to bring that back and that might lead to rich improvements for your own service, too.
sentences.zh: 如果你看到另一个服务部门在实际操作中有什么行之有效的方法，你更有可能把它带回来，这也可能会为你们自己的服务部门带来丰硕的改进。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是的。

sentences.en: And I think, especially at the beginning, we've been kind of supporting each other.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，特别是在开始的时候，我们一直在互相支持。

sentences.en: So I'd role swap and the other girl in the other service would support me in the role.
sentences.zh: 所以我去进行岗位轮换时，另一个部门的那个女孩会在那个岗位上支持我。

sentences.en: So it's not like you're completely in a new place, you're kind of being supported.
sentences.zh: 所以并不是说你完全置身于一个陌生的环境中，你是受到支持的。

sentences.en: And then slowly you can kind of just do the swap completely.
sentences.zh: 然后慢慢地，你就可以完全独立地进行轮换了。

sentences.en: And I think that can kind of help you feel more supported as well.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这也能帮你感受到更多的支持。

sentences.en: But I do think it's really helpful and I'm glad I got to know about it.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为这非常有用，而且我很高兴能了解到这一点。

sentences.en: So hopefully other people can kind of explore that option as well.
sentences.zh: 所以希望其他人也能去探索这种选择。

sentences.en: Yeah, thank you.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Well done to your supervisor.
sentences.zh: 为你主管点赞。

sentences.en: Hats off to them.
sentences.zh: 向他们致敬。

sentences.en: I'm very excited about that.
sentences.zh: 我对这个感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: And I know there'll be lots of little ears listening to this going, oh, because I was talking just on a live yesterday.
sentences.zh: 而且我知道会有很多小耳朵在听这个时会发出“哇”的感叹，因为我昨天刚好在一个直播中聊过。

sentences.en: When you get that feeling that you've plateaued and you're like, oh, no, I'm going to have to start looking for other jobs.
sentences.zh: 当你产生那种陷入瓶颈的感觉，觉得“噢不，我得开始找别的工作了”时，

sentences.en: But maybe this is a way around that, you know.
sentences.zh: 也许这就是解决问题的一种方法，你知道的。

sentences.en: So thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 所以非常感谢。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好啦。

sentences.en: So we're thinking about culture and faith.
sentences.zh: 接下来我们来谈谈文化和信仰。

sentences.en: Could you tell us a little bit for anybody who doesn't know about Islam?
sentences.zh: 对于任何不了解伊斯兰教的人，你能给我们简单讲讲吗？

sentences.en: Could you tell us a little bit about what it involves and perhaps how you slot it into your life before we then begin to think about values?
sentences.zh: 在我们开始探讨价值观之前，你能否简单介绍一下它包含的内容，以及你是如何将它融入你的生活中的？

sentences.en: So, yeah, as a Muslim, I feel like everybody kind of has their own kind of connection with faith.
sentences.zh: 好的，是的，作为一名穆斯林，我觉得每个人对信仰都有自己独特的连接方式。

sentences.en: And I think I feel like Islam is a religion, but it's also a way of life.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得伊斯兰教既是一种宗教，也是一种生活方式。

sentences.en: So I'd say that actually when we're thinking about Islam, it's kind of we have our kind of core beliefs,
sentences.zh: 所以我想说，当我们思考伊斯兰教时，我们拥有某种核心信仰，

sentences.en: which is the kind of faith in God and believe in what God has revealed to us and live in our life according to what God's ordered for us and what God wants us to do.
sentences.zh: 也就是对真主的信仰，相信真主向我们启示的一切，并按照真主为我们规定的要求以及真主希望我们做的那样去生活。

sentences.en: But I think a big part of that is actually it supports your way of life.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得其中很大一部分其实是它支撑了你的生活方式。

sentences.en: So it's not just us thinking that actually it's loads of rules and it's loads of things to abide by, but actually it's things that kind of enrich your life.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅仅意味着我们认为它有成堆的规则和必须遵守的事物，实际上，这些都是能够丰富你生活的东西。

sentences.en: And I think the main kind of value and belief that I feel like is important within being a Muslim is having that faith and actually understanding that when kind of we struggle with things or when things become hard.
sentences.zh: 并且我认为作为一名穆斯林，其中最主要的核心价值观和信仰就是拥有这种信念，并且真正理解当我们在生活中遇到挣扎或困难时，

sentences.en: And these are things that kind of strengthen our beliefs as a Muslim,
sentences.zh: 这些都是能够坚定制做穆斯林的信仰的事物，

sentences.en: but also kind of help us to kind of persevere and help us to kind of get but help us to kind of get through difficult times.
sentences.zh: 同时也帮助我们坚持不懈，帮助我们度过困难时期。

sentences.en: So I suppose when we're talking about being a Muslim, I feel like it's it can mean we can be on different journeys as a Muslim.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，当我们谈论作为一名穆斯林时，我觉得这意味着我们作为穆斯林可能会经历不同的旅程。

sentences.en: And I feel like it's all about reconnecting to our faith.
sentences.zh: 并且我觉得这一切都是为了重新与我们的信仰建立连接。

sentences.en: And so when we're talking about values, I feel like that's incredibly important as a Muslim, because as Muslim, as Muslims,
sentences.zh: 所以当我们谈论价值观时，我觉得作为一名穆斯林，这一点极其重要，因为作为穆斯林，

sentences.en: we kind of have certain values that we kind of live our lives by, but also personal values.
sentences.zh: 我们有一些用以指导生活的特定价值观，同时也有个人的价值观。

sentences.en: So when we're thinking about kind of what it means to be a Muslim, we kind of think about kind of our faith and what what God wants from us as human beings,
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们思考成为一名穆斯林意味着什么时，我们不仅会思考我们的信仰以及真主对我们作为人类的期望，

sentences.en: but also kind of how we can kind of live our life by our values and do those things as well.
sentences.zh: 还会思考我们如何按照自己的价值观生活并践行这些事情。

sentences.en: Brilliant.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for that.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你分享这些。

sentences.en: So we've spoken about values.
sentences.zh: 我们已经讨论过价值观了。

sentences.en: Now would be a good chance to introduce the values that we've gone through and you've selected for today.
sentences.zh: 现在正是个好时机，来介绍一下我们刚才讨论过并且你今天挑选的价值观。

sentences.en: So we thought it'd be better to do this bit, the bit before off camera, because otherwise it's like, what?
sentences.zh: 所以我们觉得最好把这部分、也就是镜头前之前的这部分在私下做掉，否则就会变成：“什么？”

sentences.en: Is that at me again?
sentences.zh: “又是针对我的吗？”

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: “什么？”

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: “什么？”

sentences.en: So, yeah, we've OK.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我们—好的。

sentences.en: So the first of our values is acceptance to be open to and allowing of things I dislike or don't want in myself, others and the world around me.
sentences.zh: 我们的第一个价值观是：接纳——对自我、他人以及周围世界中我不喜欢或不想要的事物保持开放和容许的态度。

sentences.en: How that sings out to you and how it's important for you, both in terms of your faith culture and your work.
sentences.zh: 这如何深深触动了你？它对你而言为什么重要，无论是在你的信仰文化还是在工作中？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I think acceptance is a value that I feel like I've started to live by.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得接纳是我开始用来指导生活的一个价值观。

sentences.en: I feel like when we're living our life by our values, we can kind of wane in terms of going back and forth in terms of actually being able to live by our values.
sentences.zh: 我觉得当我们按照价值观生活时，在真正能够践行价值观这方面，我们可能会经历来回摇摆的起伏。

sentences.en: But I feel like acceptance is a core value for me in terms of faith.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得接纳是我在信仰方面的核心价值观。

sentences.en: I feel like when difficult things, when we experience difficult things and hard things happen as a Muslim,
sentences.zh: 我觉得当作为穆斯林经历艰难困苦和困难的事情发生时，

sentences.en: I feel like actually we we kind of feel that these experiences are our tests from God and actually that they're to kind of help us to kind of move forward in life.
sentences.zh: 我觉得实际上我们会认为这些经历是真主对我们的考验，并且它们实际上是为了帮助我们在生活中继续前进。

sentences.en: And actually when difficulty kind of falls on us, that actually being able to accept what's happened helps you to kind of move on from that.
sentences.zh: 而且当困难降临在我们身上时，能够接纳所发生的事情确实能帮你从阴影中走出来。

sentences.en: And I feel like it's a big thing with me in terms of my own mental health and accepting my own experiences,
sentences.zh: 我觉得这对于我自身的心理健康和接纳自己的经历来说是一件大事，

sentences.en: because I feel like there was a time where I might have been kind of challenging how I'd been feeling and wanting to forget things or push them away.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得曾有一段时间，我可能会质疑自己的感受，想要忘记事情或者把它们推开。

sentences.en: And I found that the more that I was pushing my experiences away,
sentences.zh: 我发现我越是把自己的经历推开，

sentences.en: the more that I was struggling with them and actually having that acceptance of things happen for a reason and actually being able to move on from that has really helped me.
sentences.zh: 我就越是被它们折磨，而真正接纳“事出必有因”并能够释怀，对我真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: But I also feel like it's kind of helped me in my professional career as well.
sentences.zh: 但我也觉得它对我的职业生涯同样有所帮助。

sentences.en: So I feel like there was a time where if I experienced kind of a rejection that I would take that very personally and I'd kind of really reflect badly on myself and have a lot of feelings of shame and just feeling like I'm not good enough.
sentences.zh: 我觉得曾有一段时间，如果我经历被拒绝，我会把它看得很个人化，会狠狠地自我反省，并产生大量的羞耻感，觉得自己不够优秀。

sentences.en: And I know I've kind of applied for the doctorate course before and I know that's something that others might have experienced of where you feel where if your application isn't accepted or if you don't get that job or if you don't kind of,
sentences.zh: 我知道我以前申请过博士课程，我也知道其他人可能也经历过这种情况：当你申请没有被接受、或者没有得到那份工作、或者事情没有按照、

sentences.en: if things don't pan out the way that we want them to pan out, we really hold that personally and we get hung up on it.
sentences.zh: 如果没有按照我们希望的方向发展时，我们会把这看得非常重，并且一直纠结于此。

sentences.en: And I feel when we're able to kind of be more accepting of changes and I think that's something that I found that when I've been more accepting of changes,
sentences.zh: 我觉得当我们能够更好地接纳变化时——我觉得这是我发现的，当我更能接纳变化时，

sentences.en: it's helped me to kind of move on and reflect on things and thinking about actually what's kind of led me to this point or how can I move on from this.
sentences.zh: 它帮助我继续前进并反思事情，去思考究竟是什么把我带到了这一刻，或者我该如何从中走出来。

sentences.en: And I think previously I was very goal based when I was thinking about my career, so I was very like,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为以前我在考虑职业生涯时非常注重目标，所以我总是觉得：

sentences.en: I need to get an assistant job and then I need to get onto the course and it's all time limited and if it doesn't happen, I don't know what I'm going to do.
sentences.zh: 我需要找到一份助理的工作，然后我需要考上博士项目，这一切都是有时限的，如果做不到，我真不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: But when I started to be more accepting, I found that actually I found more enjoyment in things.
sentences.zh: 但当我开始变得更能接纳时，我发现其实我在其中找到了更多的乐趣。

sentences.en: I found that actually I could enjoy my assistant job a lot more because I was spending time enjoying my experiences rather than thinking about what's next.
sentences.zh: 我发现我可以更加享受我的助理工作，因为我把时间花在享受经历上，而不是总去想下一步是什么。

sentences.en: So that's helped me, I think.
sentences.zh: 所以我想这对我很有帮助。

sentences.en: Good, you were good.
sentences.zh: 很好，你做得很好。

sentences.en: Really pleased to hear that.
sentences.zh: 很高兴听到这些。

sentences.en: And yeah, it's about being able to look sideways as well, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 是的，这也关乎能够向两侧看，对吧？

sentences.en: Not just forwards.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是向前看。

sentences.en: And some really important, really important points you've raised there.
sentences.zh: 你提出了非常深刻、非常重要的一些观点。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好啦。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: So the second of our values is persistence to continue resolutely with your task or challenge despite problems, fears and difficulties.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的第二个价值观是：坚持——不顾问题、恐惧和困难，坚决继续你的任务或挑战。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I feel like that does relate to a little bit of what I've talked about in terms of acceptance.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这确实与我刚才谈到的接纳有一点联系。

sentences.en: But I feel like we all kind of go through things in our life where we struggle.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得我们所有人生活中都会经历挣扎的时刻。

sentences.en: And I think when I've kind of thought about back to my experiences, I feel like there was a time where I might have struggled with persistence, where I've tried to persiSt.
sentences.zh: 我想当我回想自己的经历时，我觉得曾有一段时间我可能在坚持方面有过挣扎，我曾试图去坚持，

sentences.en: And I felt that actually I wasn't able to live my life according to that value.
sentences.zh: 却发现自己其实无法按照那个价值观去生活。

sentences.en: But actually how when I was able to persist and when I was able to kind of show persistence, how effective that was for me.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，当我能够坚持、当我能够展现出毅力时，这对我来说是多么有效啊。

sentences.en: So I know when I was struggling with my mental health, I really struggled to kind of move forward and to go forward with things.
sentences.zh: 我深知当我与心理健康问题作斗争时，我真的很难向前迈进、很难把事情推进下去。

sentences.en: And I think when I had that ability to persist, it really kind of bettered me as a person, not only just how I was feeling, but kind of made me more.
sentences.zh: 我想当我拥有那种坚持的能力时，它确实让我作为一个变得更好，不仅仅是改变了我的感受，还让我变得更……

sentences.en: I feel resilient as a person.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己作为一个变得更有韧性了。

sentences.en: And I think it's something that I try to move forward in my general life when things kind of are difficult.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得这是我在遇到困难时，在日常生活中努力去贯彻的一点。

sentences.en: I feel like sometimes I can find it difficult and I might want to give up.
sentences.zh: 我觉得有时我会觉得这很难，甚至想放弃。

sentences.en: But then when I do persist, I'm grateful that I have.
sentences.zh: 但当我坚持下来时，我很庆幸自己做到了。

sentences.en: And I think everybody who's listening would have times in their life where they felt that they've kind of experienced something that was really difficult,
sentences.zh: 我想每一位正在收听的听众，在生中都会遇到这样的时刻：他们觉得自经历了非常困难的事，

sentences.en: whether that be in their personal life or professional.
sentences.zh: 无论是在个人生活中还是在职场中。

sentences.en: And I think with psychology is one of those kind of careers where persistence is really important.
sentences.zh: 我认为心理学就是那种坚持非常重要的职业之一。

sentences.en: We know actually it is a competitive kind of place, but actually how when we do persist, we can see those rewards.
sentences.zh: 我们知道这确实是一个竞争激烈的领域，但事实上，当我们坚持下去时，我们就能看到回报。

sentences.en: And I think just persisting in what we want to do in our career can be really helpful and kind of moving forward with the steps.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，在我们的职业生涯中坚持我们想做的事情，对不断向前迈进真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: And even if you do receive news that isn't what you wanted to hear, being able to kind of move forward from that shows that persistence.
sentences.zh: 即使你收到的消息并非你想听到的，能够从容面对并继续前行，就展现了这种坚持。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I do feel like we reflect that as psychologists.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我觉得我们作为心理学家确实体现了这一点。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And is there some crossover with your faith in terms of persistence as well?
sentences.zh: 那么，在坚持不懈这一点上，它与你的信仰是否有某种交集呢？

sentences.en: What does your faith teach us about persistence, for example?
sentences.zh: 例如，你的信仰对坚持教导了我们什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, so I think it's in Islam, there's a concept called sabr,
sentences.zh: 是的，在伊斯兰教中有一个概念叫萨布尔（Sabr），

sentences.en: which is basically meaning that when we go through things that are difficult or when we go through trials and tribulations,
sentences.zh: 它的基本意思是，当我们经历困难的事情，或者经历考验和磨难时，

sentences.en: that when we show persistence and we're able to kind of move forward with things, actually we're rewarded for that and we're able to kind of get benefits from that.
sentences.zh: 如果我们表现出坚持，并且能够继续前行，实际上我们会因此得到回报，并能从中获得益处。

sentences.en: And I think it's very much about we do as much as we can to change the situation and move forward.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很大程度上在于我们尽最大努力去改变现状并继续前进。

sentences.en: But in cases where we've done our best and we can't kind of change a situation, it's about kind of keeping faith,
sentences.zh: 但在我们已经尽力却无法改变现状的情况下，这就需要保持信念，

sentences.en: thinking that actually things will get better and showing that kind of ability to move forward when we can.
sentences.zh: 相信情况会好转，并在可能的时候展现出那种继续前进的能力。

sentences.en: And when things aren't, when we're not able to move forward, actually keeping faith helps us to stay grounded and move forward in our lives.
sentences.zh: 而当事情不如意、我们无法前进时，保持信念实际上能帮助我们脚踏实地，继续生活。

sentences.en: Thank you for that.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你的分享。

sentences.en: As we were talking about persistence before off camera, we also thought about the other value of patience.
sentences.zh: 正如我们之前在镜头外谈到坚持时，我们也想到了耐心的另一个价值。

sentences.en: So now might be an interesting and useful time to think about the value of patience, which might be versus persistence or in addition to persistence.
sentences.zh: 所以现在可能是一个有趣且有用的时机来思考耐心的价值，它可能与坚持相对立，也可能是对坚持的补充。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I think I was touching on it a little bit towards the end.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想我在刚才快结束时稍微触及到了这一点。

sentences.en: It kind of veered into patience where actually we think about we always kind of persist and push forward.
sentences.zh: 话题不知不觉转到了耐心上，事实上我们总是倾向于坚持和向前推进。

sentences.en: But there are points where sometimes the best thing that we can do is be patient.
sentences.zh: 但有时我们能做最好的事情反而是保持耐心。

sentences.en: And actually something like acceptance commitment therapy really sits well with me because I feel like we change what we can change and what is in our control.
sentences.zh: 事实上，像接纳承诺疗法（ACT）这样的理念非常契合我的想法，因为我觉得我们改变我们能改变的、在我们控制范围内的东西。

sentences.en: But when we when we're struggling and actually there isn't anything that we can do,
sentences.zh: 但当我们陷入困境且确实无能为力时，

sentences.en: it is about kind of accepting that I'm being patient and kind of thinking about actually there isn't anything that I can do to change the situations.
sentences.zh: 关键在于接受现状、保持耐心，并意识到确实没有什么办法可以改变当前的情况。

sentences.en: How do I move forward from here?
sentences.zh: 从这里开始我们该如何继续前行？

sentences.en: And when I was talking about persistence in relation to being a Muslim,
sentences.zh: 当我谈到作为穆斯林的坚持时，

sentences.en: I feel that patience is really important because we know when when we wait and when we keep faith that actually it can be really,
sentences.zh: 我觉得耐心非常重要，因为我们知道，当我们等待并保持信念时，这对我们作为人来说真的非常有帮助，

sentences.en: really helpful to us as as as people to to understand that sometimes things aren't in our control.
sentences.zh: 非常能够帮助我们理解有时有些事情并不在我们的掌控之中。

sentences.en: But what we can do is be patient and kind of persevere and move forward with things.
sentences.zh: 但我们能做的是保持耐心、不屈不挠并继续前行。

sentences.en: And I think within psychology, you have to be a bit patient.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为在心理学领域，你必须有那么一点耐心。

sentences.en: And I know it's one thing that I learned when I did my first Deaklin application.
sentences.zh: 我知道这是我第一次申请迪肯（Deakin）时学到的一课。

sentences.en: I didn't realise how patient I'd have to be in terms of finding out when you get if you get accepted, if you get an interview, it's a long time to wait.
sentences.zh: 我当时并没有意识到，在等待自己是否被录取、是否获得面试通知的过程中，我需要付出多少耐心，这需要等待很长时间。

sentences.en: But you definitely show that patience to be able to kind of wait through and persist and kind of spend that time to do that.
sentences.zh: 但你必须展现出那种耐心去熬过这个过程、坚持下去，并花时间去完成它。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全赞同。

sentences.en: The struggle is real.
sentences.zh: 这种挣扎太真实了。

sentences.en: It goes on a long time.
sentences.zh: 而且持续时间很长。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Oh, and anybody else who's but, you know, by the time this episode goes out, I think we will just be on the cusp of submissions for this year.
sentences.zh: 哦，对于其他所有人来说——不过你知道的，当这集播出时，我想我们刚好赶上今年的申请提交期。

sentences.en: So the waiting game begins.
sentences.zh: 所以等待的游戏开始了。

sentences.en: So, yeah, we will come back to that in future as well.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我们以后还会回过头来谈这个。

sentences.en: Thank you, Lisa.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，莉莎。

sentences.en: So the next is curiosity to be curious, open minded and interested, eager to explore, discover and learn.
sentences.zh: 接下来的价值是好奇心：保持好奇、思想开放、充满兴趣，并渴望探索、发现和学习。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I think as a Muslim, we're always encouraged to be curious.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得作为一名穆斯林，我们总是被鼓励去保持好奇心。

sentences.en: So it's always about kind of seeking knowledge and being curious about what you believe as well.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们要去寻求知识，并对自己的信仰保持好奇。

sentences.en: So when we are kind of reconnecting to our faith or connecting to our faith, we want to be able to be curious about what our faith means, what our faith means to us.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们重新与信仰建立联系或融入信仰时，我们希望能够对信仰的含义以及信仰对我们的意义充满好奇。

sentences.en: And we're encouraged to kind of seek knowledge and develop.
sentences.zh: 我们被鼓励去寻求知识并不断发展。

sentences.en: So it's not about us just saying, actually, this is what you believe and that's it.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅仅是告诉我们“这就是你的信仰，就这样了”，

sentences.en: But we always are encouraged to kind of go further and seek more knowledge and think about how that relates to us.
sentences.zh: 而是我们总是被鼓励走得更远，寻求更多的知识，并思考这些知识与我们的关系。

sentences.en: And I feel like curiosity for me as as a person is really important as well, because I feel like curiosity kind of opens the doors to being open minded.
sentences.zh: 我觉得好奇心对我个人而言也非常重要，因为它为思想开放打开了大门。

sentences.en: So when we're curious about things, we can be more accepting, we can kind of be more tolerant and things like that.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们对事物充满好奇时，我们会更有包容心，会变得更加宽容等等。

sentences.en: So I feel like within my experience within psychology, being curious has really helped me because I feel like I went when reflecting back on previous experiences,
sentences.zh: 因此我觉得在心理学领域的经历中，好奇心对我有很大帮助，因为当我回顾以往的经历时，

sentences.en: sometimes I could have been quite rigid minded and thinking actually trying to fit people into a formulation rather than the other way around.
sentences.zh: 有时我的思维可能会相当僵化，总是试图把人们套进一个心理公式里，而不是反过来去适应他们。

sentences.en: And I think when we're curious and when we kind of keep an open mind and we kind of question things,
sentences.zh: 我想当我们保持好奇心、保持开放的心态并对事物提出疑问时，

sentences.en: we can really consider like a whole situation and things and how to best support someone.
sentences.zh: 我们才能真正地全面考虑情况，思考如何最好地支持一个人。

sentences.en: But also how we can kind of move forward with our own career.
sentences.zh: 同时也能思考如何推动我们自己的职业生涯向前发展。

sentences.en: So when we're kind of curious about what we enjoy, what we find helpful, it helps us to develop as as a psychologist, but also kind of develop what we want to do going forward.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们对自己的兴趣和觉得有帮助的事物保持好奇时，这不仅有助于我们作为心理学家成长，也有助于明确我们未来想要做的事情。

sentences.en: Brilliant.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for that one.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你的分享。

sentences.en: And next one is contribution to contribute, give, help, assist, share or be generous.
sentences.zh: 下一个价值是奉献：去贡献、给予、帮助、协助、分享或慷慨待人。

sentences.en: Yeah,
sentences.zh: 是的，

sentences.en: so I feel like my journey within psychology kind of started on me reflecting on wanting to contribute and share my experience or share the share what I've learned from my experiences with people.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我在心理学领域的旅程始于我对奉献的反思，想要分享我的经验，或者与人们分享我从经历中学到的东西。

sentences.en: So being able to kind of support other people with their own mental health.
sentences.zh: 从而能够支持其他人改善心理健康。

sentences.en: And I think for many of the aspiring psychologists or psychologists, that would be similar in wanting to help people and make a contribution.
sentences.zh: 我想对于许多有志成为心理学家的人来说，他们都有着相似的想法，那就是渴望帮助他人并做出贡献。

sentences.en: And I do feel like it's a it's a profession which is really rewarding, which is which is amazing.
sentences.zh: 我也觉得这是一个非常具有回报性的职业，这太棒了。

sentences.en: And I feel like that kind of extends into kind of faith and me as a Muslim, because I feel like as as a Muslim, we're kind of encouraged to contribute.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这种精神延伸到了信仰以及我作为穆斯林的身份中，因为我觉得作为穆斯林，我们被鼓励去奉献。

sentences.en: So we're encouraged to kind of give charity, help others and and support people.
sentences.zh: 我们被鼓励去施舍慈善、帮助他人以及支持人们。

sentences.en: So actually, when when I'm working as an assistant psychologist, I feel like I'm living my life as as per my values, not only as a person and as as like as a psychologist,
sentences.zh: 所以事实上，当我作为助理心理学家工作时，我觉得我正在按照自己的价值观生活，不仅作为一个个体、一个心理学家，

sentences.en: but also kind of as a Muslim and being able to give back to people, which is really rewarding for me.
sentences.zh: 而且作为一个穆斯林，能够回馈他人，这对我来说非常有意义。

sentences.en: It must feel like double bubble.
sentences.zh: 这一定感觉像是双倍的快乐。

sentences.en: I often say I've got the best job in the world.
sentences.zh: 我经常说我拥有世界上最好的工作。

sentences.en: But if you're also like singing from your hymn sheet for your for your faith as well, as well as your own personal and professional kind of passions,
sentences.zh: 但如果你的工作不仅符合你个人的职业激情，还与你的信仰完美契合，

sentences.en: it must just feel so, I don't know, uplifting, energising, all of those good terMs.
sentences.zh: 那这种感觉一定……我不知道，极其振奋人心、充满活力，所有美好的词汇都可以用上。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对如此。

sentences.en: I feel like when you work in a in a profession where you're also able to reconnect to your values, but also to your faith, it does feel like that it feels like a double reward.
sentences.zh: 我觉得当你从事一份能够重新连接你的价值观和信仰的职业时，那感觉就像是双重回报。

sentences.en: Because I feel like when I'm supporting other people to live life by their values, it also helps me to reflect on my values and what's important to me.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得当我支持其他人按照他们的价值观生活时，这也反过来帮助我反思自己的价值观以及对我而言重要的事情。

sentences.en: And then it's almost like a kind of that thing where you practice where you preach.
sentences.zh: 这就有点像“言行一致”的实践。

sentences.en: And I think sometimes as a psychologist, we can sometimes give the best advice and not take that advice ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我想有时作为心理学家，我们能给出最好的建议，但自己却不一定去践行。

sentences.en: And I feel like that's something that's been really important to me is being able to relate the things that I use in practice to my own life as well.
sentences.zh: 而我觉得对我非常重要的一点，就是能够把我在实践中用到的方法同样应用到我自己的生活中。

sentences.en: Yeah, which I feel like has made me a better psychologist as well as a better person, I think.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得这让我不仅成为了一个更好的心理学家，也成为了一个更好的人。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: There's a recent episode I did about using our own skills to kind of navigate our own mental health.
sentences.zh: 我最近做过一期播客，讲的是如何运用我们自己的技能来应对我们自己的心理健康问题。

sentences.en: And once we start to do that, it's not it's not rocket science, is it?
sentences.zh: 一旦我们开始这样做，这其实并非什么高深莫测的科学，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, when the stuff we're saying is brilliant, when we actually use it, we do feel better.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当我们真正去践行我们所说的那些精彩观点时，我们的确会感觉更好。

sentences.en: You know, of course, we should be doing it and we should make time for it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们当然应该这样做，而且应该为此腾出时间。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I totally agree.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我完全赞同。

sentences.en: And the last of our identified values is compassion to be acting kindly towards ourselves and or others when in pain.
sentences.zh: 我们确认的最后一个价值观是同情心：在痛苦时对自己和/或他人表现出善意。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I feel like I've always been quite compassionate towards other people and I feel like kind of choosing psychology as a career kind of helped me to live my life according to being compassionate.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得我对别人一直都挺有同情心的，而且选择心理学作为职业也帮助我按照同情心的原则生活。

sentences.en: I feel like one of the things that I've always struggled with is using that compassion towards myself.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我一直以来感到困难的一点，是将这种同情心应用到自己身上。

sentences.en: And I feel like that's a very hard thing to do.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是一件很难做到的事情。

sentences.en: But when we are able to do it and we're able to build those skills, it makes things so much better and it makes you be able to reflect on things so much better.
sentences.zh: 但当我们能够做到这一点并培养出这些能力时，事情就会变得好得多，并且能让你对事物有更好的反思。

sentences.en: So I feel like when when I am able to be more self compassionate,
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，当我能够对自己多一些同情时，

sentences.en: I do feel like I get more reward out of things because actually I feel like sometimes we can be quite hard on ourselves and we live life according to our values in terms of showing compassion to other people.
sentences.zh: 我确实觉得我能从中获得更多的收获，因为事实上我觉得有时我们对自己相当苛刻，虽然我们在对他人表现同情时遵循了价值观，

sentences.en: But sometimes don't apply those same values to ourselves.
sentences.zh: 但有时却没有把同样的价值观应用在自己身上。

sentences.en: And I think that can be really, really important.
sentences.zh: 我认为这真的非常非常重要。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I think that has helped incredibly, I think.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我认为这带来了难以置信的帮助。

sentences.en: It really can.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And I know I keep saying about all the stuff that happens off camera and people are like, why can we listen to the off camera?
sentences.zh: 我知道我一直在提镜头外发生的那些事，人们可能会问：为什么我们不能听听镜头外的内容？

sentences.en: One of the least downloaded episodes of this podcast series is the one on self compassion.
sentences.zh: 在这个播客系列中，下载量最少的几期之一就是关于自我同情的那一期。

sentences.en: And actually, that's the one that's going to be the difference that makes a difference.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，那恰恰是能带来改变的关键所在。

sentences.en: So everybody download that one as well, because you're so right.
sentences.zh: 所以大家也去下载那一期吧，因为你们说得太对了。

sentences.en: It's so important.
sentences.zh: 这真的太重要了。

sentences.en: And just before we finish, because I'm aware of the time, I picked up a couple of values that I thought might be useful for us to kind of talk to as one point, really,
sentences.zh: 就在我们结束之前，因为考虑到时间，我挑出了几个我认为我们可以一起探讨的价值观，

sentences.en: really based on my observations of having worked in a central Birmingham service with people who who follow Islam.
sentences.zh: 这很大程度上基于我在伯明翰一家服务机构工作的观察，那里的服务对象都是信仰伊斯兰教的人。

sentences.en: And I guess, you know, going to Friday prayers and for the male members of the staff, I don't know if it's open to women yet.
sentences.zh: 我想（男员工们）会去参加周五的主麻聚礼，我不知道现在是否对女性开放了。

sentences.en: I'm not sure.
sentences.zh: 我不确定。

sentences.en: Perhaps culturally naive of me to admit that.
sentences.zh: 承认这一点可能显得我有些文化无知。

sentences.en: But at the time when I was there, it was it was males only for Friday prayers and stopping and having prayer rooms and things like that.
sentences.zh: 但在我当时在那里的时候，周五聚礼是仅限男性的，而且当时也有专门停下来进行礼拜的祈祷室之类的地方。

sentences.en: And also for people not watching on YouTube, you're a hijab wearer.
sentences.zh: 而且对于没有在YouTube上观看的听众来说，你是一位戴头巾的女性。

sentences.en: And so, you know, I'm aware that, you know, there's different thoughts and feelings and expectations of people accessing services about, I guess,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我知道在使用服务的群体中，人们会有不同的想法、感受和期望，关于，我想说，

sentences.en: a number of factors that are not always nice, you know, to be blunt about that.
sentences.zh: 许多并不总是那么美好的因素，坦白来讲。

sentences.en: I guess I was thinking about assertiveness, respect, flexibility and freedom, you know, so to other people to have freedom of choice and actions,
sentences.zh: 我想到了自信、尊重、灵活性和自由，你知道的，让其他人拥有选择和行动的自由，

sentences.en: but also being respectful and your assertiveness to be able to stop and say,
sentences.zh: 但同时也要保持尊重，并具备自信能够停下来并说：

sentences.en: I do need to stop now because I need to do this or I can't do that because that's outside of what I what I'm what I believe or what I feel comfortable with.
sentences.zh: “我确实需要停下来，因为我需要做这个；或者我不能那样做，因为那超出了我的信仰或我感到舒适的范围。”

sentences.en: But also whether there's any room for flexibility around some of this.
sentences.zh: 但同时也探讨这其中是否有一定的灵活性空间。

sentences.en: Is it OK to have a brief conversation about some of that, Leisha?
sentences.zh: 莉莎，我们可不可以简短地聊一聊其中的一些话题？

sentences.en: Yeah, that sounds like a good conversation.
sentences.zh: 好的，听起来是个不错的探讨方向。

sentences.en: I feel like one of the things to kind of point out is I definitely feel like there are rules with with all religions and all kind of cultures, I feel like as well.
sentences.zh: 我觉得有一点需要指出来，那就是我绝对觉得所有的宗教和所有的文化中都有相应的规则。

sentences.en: So I feel like we all kind of have points of assertiveness and things that we kind of morally want to want to do or believe.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得我们所有人都有表现自信的时刻，也有我们在道德上想要去做或坚信的事情。

sentences.en: And I feel like that's kind of exists in all of us.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这种特质存在于我们每个人身上。

sentences.en: And I think when we're thinking about religion, I feel like it's really important to think, yeah,
sentences.zh: 当我们在思考宗教时，我觉得非常重要的一点是要认识到，是的，

sentences.en: there's definitely things that we should do and things that we shouldn't do in terms of what we believe as MusliMs.
sentences.zh: 作为穆斯林，根据我们的信仰，确实有些事情是我们应该做的，有些事情是不应该做的。

sentences.en: And I feel like when we're thinking about assertiveness,
sentences.zh: 当我们思考自信时，

sentences.en: I suppose the reason that we do it is because of our devotion to what what we've been told by God and what's been instructed by us by God.
sentences.zh: 我想我们这样做的原因，是因为我们对真主（安拉）的教导以及真主对我们的指示抱有虔诚的信仰。

sentences.en: And I think when we're thinking about assertiveness as well,
sentences.zh: 当我们思考自信时，

sentences.en: I think it's it's helpful to think about things in terms of we have that kind of trust and and belief that the things that have been kind of that have been decreed to us and the things that we are told to do help us to live a better life.
sentences.zh: 我认为这样思考会很有帮助：我们怀有一种信任和信念，即真主所颁布给我们的事物以及吩咐我们去做的事情，能够帮助我们过上更好的生活。

sentences.en: And actually,
sentences.zh: 事实上，

sentences.en: when we're thinking about being a Muslim and we think about kind of giving charity and that's something that's ordained on us and and fasting to kind of consider people who are less fortunate and all those kind of things.
sentences.zh: 当我们思考作为穆斯林并施舍慈善时，这是真主对我们的命令；还有封斋，以此去体恤那些不幸的人等等。

sentences.en: It helps you to reflect on on yourself as a person, but helps you to live a life according to your values and helps you to kind of live as a better person.
sentences.zh: 这不仅有助于你作为一个人进行反思，还有助于你按照自己的价值观生活，并帮助你成为一个更好的人。

sentences.en: And I suppose we have that belief that God knows better than us.
sentences.zh: 我想我们坚信真主比我们更了解一切。

sentences.en: And I suppose sometimes our kind of desires or the things that we want to do might kind of go against our values.
sentences.zh: 有时候我们的欲望或我们想做的事情可能会与我们的价值观相冲突。

sentences.en: And it's thinking about how we can live our life according to our values.
sentences.zh: 这就需要思考我们如何才能按照自己的价值观生活。

sentences.en: And even if we do things that we're not supposed to do or doing things that kind of take us away from our values,
sentences.zh: 即使我们做了不该做的事，或者做了一些背离我们价值观的事，

sentences.en: I think a big thing within Islam is is being able to to notice that and and then seeking forgiveness for that for it.
sentences.zh: 我认为在伊斯兰教中非常重要的一点是能够察觉到这一点，并为此寻求宽恕。

sentences.en: But then kind of going back to living our life by our values.
sentences.zh: 然后重新回归到按照我们的价值观生活上来。

sentences.en: So I feel like sometimes when we're thinking about things, it's about how actually we know that we all kind of at points in our lives go go move away from our values.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得有时当我们思考这些事情时，实际上是在于：我们知道我们大家在人生的某些阶段都会背离自己的价值观。

sentences.en: But the important part is is kind of noticing that and coming back because we know nobody's perfect and it's hard when we kind of hold ourselves to perfection.
sentences.zh: 但重要的一部分是去察觉到这一点并回归正轨，因为我们知道没有人是完美的，当我们对自己抱有完美的期待时，这很难做到。

sentences.en: But when we understand that actually as humans, we we aren't perfect and we can't do things all the time,
sentences.zh: 但当我们明白，作为人类，我们并不完美，也无法时时刻刻都把事情做好时，

sentences.en: then we're more likely to kind of reflect on on ourselves and then being able to live our life by our values more.
sentences.zh: 我们就更有可能反思自己，从而更好地按照价值观生活。

sentences.en: And and I feel like that's where kind of forgiveness kind of freedom as well.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这就是宽恕和自由发挥作用的地方。

sentences.en: We we believe that everybody has the freedom to choice.
sentences.zh: 我们坚信每个人都有选择的自由。

sentences.en: Everybody has a freedom to believe what they want to believe.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有相信自己想相信的事物的自由。

sentences.en: And there's no kind of force or there's no kind of compulsion within religion.
sentences.zh: 宗教中没有强迫，也没有勉强。

sentences.en: So you are kind of held accountable for what you do.
sentences.zh: 因此，你要为自己的行为承担责任，

sentences.en: But if if you don't if you don't believe in Islam or if you don't kind of believe in those things, you have a freedom to do that.
sentences.zh: 但如果你不信仰伊斯兰教，或者你不相信那些事情，你完全有这样做的自由。

sentences.en: But I suppose that's that's then your kind of responsibility.
sentences.zh: 不过我想那应该算是你的一种责任。

sentences.en: But it doesn't mean that you don't have the freedom to kind of choose.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着你没有那种选择的自由。

sentences.en: And yeah, I think that that then ties into respect.
sentences.zh: 而且是的，我认为这其实与尊重息息相关。

sentences.en: And I think a big thing that we're taught is respecting people despite their differences.
sentences.zh: 并且我认为我们被教导的一个重要原则，就是超越彼此的差异去尊重他人。

sentences.en: So no matter what your kind of religion or culture, that actually we should treat people with respect and kindness.
sentences.zh: 所以无论你的宗教或文化背景如何，实际上我们都应该以尊重和善意对待他人。

sentences.en: And that's something that I suppose when you kind of look at the life of the prophet, peace be upon him, he kind of showed that within his life work.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是为什么，当你了解先知（愿主赐福与他）的一生时，会发现他在其一生的事业中就展现了这一点。

sentences.en: And I think we kind of take our role models, how we should be living as Muslims and what our values should be from the prophet.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们作为穆斯林，我们的榜样、我们该如何生活以及我们的价值观，都是从先知那里汲取的。

sentences.en: And that's how we kind of aim to live our lives.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们一直努力的生活方式。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I feel like that might have touched upon the different parts.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我觉得这可能触及了不同的方面。

sentences.en: But I think from my reflections as a Muslim, that's what what I would believe.
sentences.zh: 但我想从我作为一名穆斯林的思考来看，这就是我的信念。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Brilliant.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: And thank you for also mentioning fasting, because that's a very big and important part of your faith.
sentences.zh: 也谢谢你提到了斋戒，因为这是你们信仰中非常宏大且重要的一部分。

sentences.en: And something that, you know, I've supported clients through as well.
sentences.zh: 这也是我曾经在工作中支持过客户的一个方面。

sentences.en: And I always, from my perspective, I feel like I would dread that time of the year.
sentences.zh: 从我的角度来看，我总觉得我会对一年中的那个时期感到畏惧。

sentences.en: But actually, all of the clients I've worked with love it.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，我共事过的所有客户都非常喜欢它。

sentences.en: You know, they find it really energizing.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们觉得这真的能让人充满活力。

sentences.en: They find it a really nice time to come together with their families and their community.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得这是一个与家人和社区团聚的极好时光。

sentences.en: And they really feel like it's a privilege and they really enjoy it and benefit from it.
sentences.zh: 他们真的觉得这是一种特权，并且非常享受其中、从中受益。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: And I think when you when you think about fasting, everyone's thinking, oh, you can't eat and drink for a really long time.
sentences.zh: 而且我想当你想到斋戒时，每个人都会想，哦，有很长一段时间不能吃东西和喝水。

sentences.en: And that's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And I think when we think about Ramadan, it's more than than just fasting.
sentences.zh: 我想当我们想到斋月时，它的意义远不止于斋戒本身。

sentences.en: So I suppose when we're in Ramadan, it's a time of reflection and reconnecting to faith.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，当我们在过斋月时，这是一个反思和重新连接信仰的时期。

sentences.en: And I feel like that's a time where we kind of remove distractions.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这也是一个让我们排除干扰的时期。

sentences.en: So we try our best to refocus.
sentences.zh: 所以我们尽最大努力重新聚焦。

sentences.en: And I think the reason that we enjoy it so much is because it gives us that chance to live our life by our values and reconnect.
sentences.zh: 我想我们之所以如此享受它，是因为它给了我们一个按价值观生活的机会，并让我们重新建立联系。

sentences.en: And I think sometimes life takes over and sometimes we move away from our values.
sentences.zh: 有时生活会占据我们的全部，有时我们会背离自己的价值观。

sentences.en: But having that time sometimes helps us to realize kind of why our values are important to us.
sentences.zh: 但拥有这样一段时光，有时能帮我们意识到为什么这些价值观对我们如此重要。

sentences.en: But then also being able to kind of reconnect and thinking about reflection as well,
sentences.zh: 同时也能让我们重新建立联系，并去思考反思这件事，

sentences.en: because I think it's a big period of time where we reflect on ourselves and where we want to be,
sentences.zh: 因为我认为这是一个很长的时期，我们在其中反思自我以及我们想要成为什么样的人，

sentences.en: but also reflecting on those who are less fortunate to us and and helping those as well.
sentences.zh: 同时也会反思那些不如我们幸运的人，并去帮助他们。

sentences.en: So kind of like giving charity and things like that is something that's a big part of our religion to help other people.
sentences.zh: 所以像做慈善之类的事情，是帮助他人、也是我们宗教中非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: Lovely.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And before we finish, when we're working in services, you know, we have the right to receive dignity, respect and no hostility from people.
sentences.zh: 在我们结束之前，当我们在服务机构工作时，你知道的，我们有权获得尊严、尊重，并且不遭受人们的敌意。

sentences.en: But when I've worked in services, that hasn't always been the case.
sentences.zh: 但当我曾在服务机构工作时，情况并非总是如此。

sentences.en: And so it's just for us to pay lip service to the fact that if you're not feeling like people are respecting you,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果我们只是嘴上说说——即如果你觉得人们没有尊重你，

sentences.en: regardless of your culture, regardless of your background, or perhaps in spite of your culture and background,
sentences.zh: 无论你的文化如何，无论你的背景如何，或者也许正是因为你的文化和背景，

sentences.en: that you don't need to tolerate any kind of substandard treatment from service users.
sentences.zh: 你都不需要容忍来自服务使用者的任何不达标的对待。

sentences.en: And certainly within the NHS, there's a zero tolerance process for accepting that.
sentences.zh: 当然，在英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）内部，对于这种行为是零容忍的。

sentences.en: And that is a criminal offence to to rule people and single people out because of their culture and their faith.
sentences.zh: 因为文化和信仰而排挤和针对他人，这是一种刑事犯罪。

sentences.en: And I hope that's not cropped up for you.
sentences.zh: 我希望你没有遇到过这种情况。

sentences.en: But I know that in modern Britain, certainly that's not always the case for for all MusliMs.
sentences.zh: 但我也知道，在现代英国，对所有穆斯林而言，情况并非总是如此。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think when when I'm reflecting on my own experiences, I feel like it has been the case sometimes.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想当我反思自己的经历时，我觉得有时确实会遇到这种情况。

sentences.en: And I think sometimes it's very hard to identify, I think, because I feel like when we're thinking about diversity and inclusion,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为有时很难去识别它，因为我觉得当我们思考多元化和包容性时，

sentences.en: I feel like we are now kind of more diverse in the psychology profession and within the UK.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们在心理学行业以及英国国内，现在似乎变得更加多元化了。

sentences.en: But I suppose when we're thinking about discrimination and things like that, I feel like within the UK, it can be quite subtle.
sentences.zh: 但我想当我们想到歧视之类的事情时，我觉得在英国，这可能会相当微妙。

sentences.en: Microaggressions.
sentences.zh: 微攻击。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: That's a word.
sentences.zh: 这就是那个词。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think sometimes it's very hard to kind of pinpoint and address when they are microaggressions.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为有时很难准确指出并处理这些微攻击。

sentences.en: But I feel like they can be just as harmful as things that are kind of more straightforward and obvious.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得它们的危害，可能和那些更直接、更明显的行为一样大。

sentences.en: But I think when when we are thinking about our differences in cultures, I do feel like when we're thinking about service users,
sentences.zh: 不过我想，当我们思考彼此文化的差异时，我确实觉得在面对服务使用者时，

sentences.en: it can sometimes really, really help when we're working with service users to think about what, you know, our social graces
sentences.zh: 在与服务使用者共事时，思考我们的社会礼仪（social graces）有时真的、真的很有帮助，

sentences.en: and thinking about services and social graces and thinking about kind of the impact of culture, religion and loads of different kind of diversities.
sentences.zh: 去思考服务与社会礼仪，并思考文化、宗教以及各种不同多元性的影响。

sentences.en: But I suppose when we're working with clients, we can kind of come across that where we do kind of experience those microaggressions.
sentences.zh: 但我想在与客户共事时，我们确实可能会遇到经历这些微攻击的情况。

sentences.en: And I think it's it's important to reflect on that.
sentences.zh: 我认为对此进行反思是很重要的。

sentences.en: And I think in my own experiences, I've done my best as I can as a practitioner,
sentences.zh: 我想在我自己的经历中，作为一名从业者，我已经尽力做到最好，

sentences.en: but then kind of reflecting back in supervision and thinking, actually, that's not something that I should have to tolerate.
sentences.zh: 但随后在督导中回过头来思考时会发现，其实我不应该去容忍这种事。

sentences.en: So where do we go from from here?
sentences.zh: 那么我们接下来该怎么办呢？

sentences.en: And I think supervision is a great place, I think, to be able to to identify how that affects us,
sentences.zh: 我认为督导是一个极好的场所，能够让我们识别这些情况对我们产生了什么影响，

sentences.en: because I think sometimes within sessions we can think about kind of the impact on the services.
sentences.zh: 因为我想有时在会谈中，我们会去思考对服务对象的影响。

sentences.en: But when you're kind of being on the receiving end of microaggressions and potential discrimination, that's going to affect affect you as a person.
sentences.zh: 但当你处于微攻击和潜在歧视的承受端时，这将会影响你作为一个人的状态。

sentences.en: And I think that's where we can kind of identify how things can change or how you can be supported with that, which I think is really important as well.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是我们能够找出如何改变，或者如何获得相关支持的地方，我认为这也是非常重要的。

sentences.en: But yeah, sorry, I've completely forgot what the original question was.
sentences.zh: 不过，不好意思，我完全忘了原本的问题是什么了。

sentences.en: That's all right.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: You did really well.
sentences.zh: 你表现得真的很棒。

sentences.en: I was just trying to Google the name, because when you mentioned social graces, I was trying to remember his name, but it's John Burnham and his work around social graces.
sentences.zh: 我刚才只是在努力用谷歌搜索那个名字，因为当你提到社会礼仪时，我在努力回想他的名字，是约翰·伯恩姆（John Burnham）及其关于社会礼仪的工作。

sentences.en: And if anyone knows, John, I have invited him on the podcast and I haven't heard back, but I'd love to have him on the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 如果有人认识约翰，我曾邀请他来参加播客，但还没收到回复，不过我很希望能邀请他来播客做客。

sentences.en: So I have had the fortune of being taught by him a couple of times and I'd love to have him on.
sentences.zh: 我有幸听过他几次课，非常希望能邀请他来。

sentences.en: So if you are working in a service with John Burnham, give him a prod and invite him on the podcast and get in contact with me.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你正在和约翰·伯恩姆共事，请提醒他一下，邀请他来上播客并和我联系。

sentences.en: Alicia, thank you so much for today.
sentences.zh: 艾莉西亚，非常感谢你今天的到来。

sentences.en: It's been such a richly enjoyable, rewarding podcast episode.
sentences.zh: 这是一期内容丰富、令人享受且受益匪浅的播客节目。

sentences.en: I've really, really enjoyed it.
sentences.zh: 我真的、真的很喜欢。

sentences.en: It's been lovely getting to know more about you and your culture and your faith and your work as well.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能更多地了解你、你的文化、你的信仰以及你的工作。

sentences.en: If I could give out deeply inside places, you know, I'd give you one.
sentences.zh: 如果我可以发放深造培训名额的话，你知道的，我一定会给你一个。

sentences.en: Because I think you sound so ready for training.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得你听起来已经完全准备好接受培训了。

sentences.en: You really sound very thoughtful and competent and professional.
sentences.zh: 你听起来真的很深思熟虑、能力出众且专业。

sentences.en: And, you know, I feel like our young people are in safe hands with you.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我觉得我们的年轻人交到你手上是很安全的。

sentences.en: Thank you for so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: I think I feel really special for me for being able to kind of come on and share my experiences.
sentences.zh: 我觉得能来这里分享我的经历，让我感到非常荣幸和特殊。

sentences.en: But yeah, if you were giving out deeply in places, I'd take one.
sentences.zh: 不过，是的，如果你要发放深造名额，我绝对会接受一个。

sentences.en: So, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: Well, wishing you all the best with the upcoming season.
sentences.zh: 祝你接下来的申请季一切顺利。

sentences.en: You know, I don't know if you've got your application in already or whether you're about to get that ticked off and sent off.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我不知道你是否已经提交了申请，还是正准备把最后的事项勾选完毕并发送出去。

sentences.en: You don't have to queue at the post office like I did now.
sentences.zh: 你现在不用像我当年那样去邮局排队了。

sentences.en: It's more of an electronic process.
sentences.zh: 这更多是一个电子流程。

sentences.en: But yeah, wishing you the best of luck with this.
sentences.zh: 不过，是的，祝你在这方面好运。

sentences.en: And yeah, do stay in my world.
sentences.zh: 还有，请继续关注我的动态。

sentences.en: Please stay interactive with my stuff on LinkedIn because I always love our little chats.
sentences.zh: 请继续在领英上与我的内容互动，因为我总是很喜欢我们的短暂交流。

sentences.en: So thank you so much for joining me and for being our first aspiring psychologist on the Aspiring Psychologist podcast, which took me almost 10 months.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你加入我，并成为《渴望成为心理学家》播客的第一位有志成为心理学家的嘉宾，这花了我将近 10 个月的时间。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: It was a pleasure to be able to be on here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能够来到这里。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for listening.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家的收听。

sentences.en: I hope you found that as, you know, invigorating and interesting and inspiring as I did.
sentences.zh: 我希望你们能像我一样，觉得这期节目既振奋人心、有趣又充满启发。

sentences.en: I feel excited for Alicia's future.
sentences.zh: 我为艾莉西亚的未来感到兴奋。

sentences.en: If you have really liked the idea of aspiring psychologists being on the Aspiring Psychologist podcast and you think you've got an interesting story to tell and you'd like to talk to me about it and talk to our listeners about it,
sentences.zh: 如果你真的很喜欢让有志成为心理学家的人上《渴望成为心理学家》播客这个主意，并且你觉得你有一个有趣的故事想讲，想和我以及我们的听众聊聊，

sentences.en: then please do slip into my DMs on my socials.
sentences.zh: 那么请务必通过我的社交媒体私信我。

sentences.en: You can find me, Dr. Marianne Trent, most places.
