sentences.zh: 你基本上在各处都能找到我，玛丽安·特伦特博士（Dr. Marianne Trent）。

sentences.en: Please do come and connect.
sentences.zh: 请务必来和我建立联系。

sentences.en: I do really enjoy helping you celebrate your wins.
sentences.zh: 我真的非常喜欢帮你们庆祝你们的胜利。

sentences.en: So please do connect with me.
sentences.zh: 所以请务必与我建立联系。

sentences.en: And if you would welcome even more support and encouragement, do think about coming along to the Aspiring Psychologist membership where you can join us for £30 a month.
sentences.zh: 如果你希望获得更多的支持和鼓励，可以考虑加入“渴望成为心理学家”会员群，每月只需 30 英镑即可加入我们。

sentences.en: And we think about ways of advancing you professionally and personally.
sentences.zh: 我们在其中探讨如何在专业和个人层面上提升自己。

sentences.en: We've got all sorts of good stuff in there, including monthly CBT formulation and skills,
sentences.zh: 里面有各种各样的好东西，包括每月的 CBT（认知行为疗法）构建设想与技能，

sentences.en: as well as other guest sessions from other specialist people each month to looking at research, psychodynamic approaches, systemic cat approaches and loads more.
sentences.zh: 以及每个月来自其他专家的嘉宾讲座，涵盖研究、心理动力学方法、系统性 CAT 方法等等。

sentences.en: As well as your weekly chance to catch up with me, ask me any questions you like.
sentences.zh: 此外，你每周还有机会与我交流，向我提出任何你喜欢的问题。

sentences.en: And of course, our monthly group Zooms as well with me.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有我和你一起参加的每月 Zoom 小组会议。

sentences.en: So, yeah, there's absolutely loads going on.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，里面真的有超级多的内容。

sentences.en: It's a lovely place to be.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常棒的地方。

sentences.en: So do please give it some consideration if you think it might be a good fit for you.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得这可能适合你，请务必认真考虑一下。

sentences.en: For more information, check out the show notes or you can check out any of the links in my bios on my socials.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请查看节目简介，或查看我社交媒体个人简介中的任何链接。

sentences.en: In the meantime, do come and join us in the Aspiring Psychologist Community free group on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，欢迎加入我们在 Facebook 上的“渴望成为心理学家”免费社群。

sentences.en: And we can talk about this episode and how perhaps your intersectionality crops up for you in psychology.
sentences.zh: 我们可以一起讨论这期节目，以及你的交叉性（intersectionality）如何在你的心理学经历中体现。

sentences.en: So, yeah, thank you again for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，再次感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: And, yeah, I'll look forward to catching up with you in our next episode, which will be available from 6 a.m.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们下期节目见，下期节目将于周一上午 6 点发布。

sentences.en: on Monday.
sentences.zh: 照顾好自己。

sentences.en: Take care of you.
sentences.zh: 照顾好自己。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your waiSt.
sentences.zh: 有了这个播客陪伴在你身旁，你将稳步前行（原文waiSt为口误，此处意译为前行）。

sentences.en: The Aspiring Psychologist with Dr. Marianne.
sentences.zh: 《渴望成为心理学家》与玛丽安博士同行。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你能通过超越“出售时间换取金钱”的方式来赚钱，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名临床心理学家，自 2019 年以来我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One2Money program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特（Sophie Foote）的“One2Money”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，例如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于 2022 年完成了该项目，此后也一直支持两期心理学家学员走过他们的成长之旅。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我个人的独家支持套餐，无需额外付费。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四次小组智囊团指导、大师班、个性化指导、一份福南梅森（Fortnum & Mason）礼品，以及限时一对一教练辅导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10 p.m.
sentences.zh: 报名将于 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
